newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: New Colombian defense minister officially named.
newsitem.headline: New Colombian defense minister officially named.

text.p: President Ernesto Samper officially named Guillermo Alberto Gonzalez, Colombia's ambassador to Caracas, as his new defence minister on Thursday.

Gonzalez, 55, is a civil engineer, a former labour minister and Colombia's envoy to Venezuela for the last nine months. He will replace Juan Carlos Esguerra, who officially steps down next week to take up the vacant post of Colombia's ambassador to Washington.
